entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The chess Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/chess*, with the static game, the GameRoom Durable Objects and the D1 database chess.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/chess/.
entities.deployedBy: The Deploy workflow on every push to main that changes games/chess (or anything under .github/); by hand with Run workflow; or npm run deploy (npm test, npm run test:godot, npm run build, wrangler deploy) with Godot 4.7.2 and a Cloudflare token.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
A reviewer on the repository's production environment, if one is set.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded. The Deploy workflow deploys only from main, so going back means merging a revert, which deploys it. A database change is not undone by this; it is applied by hand and written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. The Durable Object class GameRoom came with migration rooms-v1, which must stay. One-time set-up (the database, the login service's keys in ACCOUNTS_JWKS, and optionally Resend) is in the README's Deploy section and the runbooks.
